headlines.text: Looking back to 2021, when Darby Allin vs. Brian Cage clashed for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.75 ? a match that delivered. A hard-fought battle for the gold.
Looking back to 2024, when FTR & Garcia didn't ease in ? their first AEW match was the main event as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 7.96 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.

It was 2023 when Ruby Soho vs. Willow Nightingale vs. Anna Jay AS vs. Tay Melo fought it out in a Street Fight match, in the show-closing main event slot on Rampage, rated 7.34 ? a match that delivered.

secondaries.text: On this day in 2024, Bill & Starks vs. Le Sex Gods went to battle over the AEW World Tag Team Titles in a Street Fight match, appearing on Battle of the Belts, rated 7.47 ? a strong outing. Le Sex Gods was challenging for gold for the very first time.
2021 brought us this moment: Danny Limelight touched down in AEW for the first time, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.38.
It was 2021 when the NWA World Women's Title was up for grabs as Serena Deeb vs. Tay Conti went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.23. Tay Conti was challenging for gold for the very first time.
